task_reconstruction.official_task: 2024 MCM Problem C, momentum in a tennis match, addressed to coaches.
required_outputs: a model of the flow of a match that includes the serve
a test of a coach's claim that momentum does not matter
a forecast of the turning points and the indicators behind them

section_map.summary: abstract: two models, three preparation steps, four problems
introduction: a quotation, a comeback, and a restatement
assumptions: six bullets, each with a because
data: one match dropped, one column divided before it is repaired
model-establishment: a windowed label and an XGBoost fit
results: the random match against the real one
model-establishment: changepoint bands, then a network that classifies them
sensitivity: serve speed and running distance, both directions

contributions.summary: The label is built from the recent points and adjusted for the server before the model is trained.
The coach's claim is turned into a match drawn from a uniform distribution and scored by the rules.
The turning points are reported as bands and checked against four named events.
Three kernel sizes stand for three time scales, and every run is reported.

dependency_graph.label: The trained model scores the real matches and the drawn ones.
The changepoint regions are the labels the network classifies.

assumptions.summary: The two players' momentum sums to a constant, so player 2 is derived from player 1.
The effect is short-term and stable inside a local window.
Some momentum carries from one game to the next, so the start of a game is not a clean slate.
Anything outside the table is ignored, and the distance run stands for exertion.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Outliers fall outside the 1.5 IQR fence and are replaced by interpolation inside the match.
Running distance is divided by the rally count before the outliers are repaired, then multiplied back.
Match 2023-wimbledon-1310 is dropped for a run of missing serve speeds. Thirty sets remain.
A double fault makes speed and rally count zero. The row at 3:05:04 has no double fault and a rally count of 3, so its gap is real.
The winner's shot type is coded as two dummy columns, because 1, 2, 3 would invent an order.
Removal stops when dropping set_no cuts the accuracy from 95.5 to 66.1 percent. Eighteen variables remain.

models.summary: MU-C-Q246-001: XGBoost on a windowed momentum label, serving factor 0.1.
MU-C-Q246-002: a random match as the counterfactual, no equation of its own.
MU-C-Q246-003: Bayesian online changepoint detection, marks reported as bands.
MU-C-Q246-004: a temporal network with kernels of size 3, 5 and 7.

verification.summary: Real against random, six metrics. The prose and Table 5 disagree.
Four bands checked against four events.
Serve speed by 5 percent, distance by 10 percent, both directions.

results_trace.summary: Pearson 0.9408 to 0.9591 on the real matches, near zero on the random ones.
Distance first, then the break points, then the scoring streak.

writing_logic.summary: The summary names both models before it describes either, and counts the preparation.
Every assumption comes with its reason, and one reason is common sense.
The claim waits until the random case has had its own sentence.
A result in the wrong shape is defended with a because.
The remedies are conditional on a failure that did not happen.
The letter retells the work in five adverbs and signs a name.

language_observations.summary: Has always been a subject of great interest. Besides, are key to victory. Before, subsequently, finally.
Despite a rocky start, tenaciously fought back. An elusive, subjective concept, one that defies direct measurement.
Implicitly embedded, explicitly reflecting. Conversely, such a mapping would be impossible.
In contrast, close to zero, failing to. In summary, not random, and plays a significant role.
I am writing to propose. Visonary, leaning. Not only serves as a reference but also provides. Warm regards, Bill.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The paper prints both the prose ranges and the contradictory random row, so the disagreement stays visible.
All five runs are printed, including the two below 74 percent, and the summary's 75.70 is left as the best of them.

weaknesses.summary: The prose random row and Table 5's random row are different numbers, and a column is never defined.
The changepoint prior and the hazard are named and never valued.
The final layer is written on the first pooled branch only, and the batch is described as video.
The letter dates the women's match to 2003.

independent_extensions.summary: Value the changepoint prior and the hazard, which the paper names and never numbers, and rebuild the bands.
Connect the second and third pooled branches to the output, which the printed final layer leaves out.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Open on the sport and split the causes of victory before naming a model.
Give the failed case its own sentence before the claim.
